## Failed requests and exact host-pin limitation

`PUBLIC-READ-GAPS.md` records two public opens that failed and were stopped without retry or alternate acquisition: the explicit DataFusion55.2.0 trait URL and DuckDB's exact-pin include tree. A successful redirect on S7 or an existing primary PDF read is not a retry of either failure. Coordinator explicitly permits unaffected theory/docs continuation and assigns actual-v2 acquisition to lane A.

Task-supplied host direction remains **actual unstable DuckDB C APIv2**, declared2.0.0, source pin `d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa`. This lane did not verify its public headers or current/private allocation/cancellation/error APIs. It must not infer an API is absent from unread source, silently adopt stable C ABI, or treat generic documentation as pin compatibility. S7's advertised host setting does not prove private-loop polling or complete private-memory accounting.

Only primary papers, author-hosted copies, official project API/documentation and the RFC text support findings. Other search hits and source-page machine/profiling/diagnostic examples were not used. Public web reads were the only remote acquisition; no networking shell, local package/source download, import/parser/compiler/DB/configuration/profiling/benchmark/system or SDK/process/clock probe occurred. No external write, Git/Page mutation, deletion, old/stopped/paused payload read or Codex/subagent. All item6 empirical stages UNRUN.
